308.en: Each Advance in a Characteristic raises the Characteristic by 1. Unless stated otherwise, the Characteristics of a normal Human cannot rise above 60. Each Advance in a Skill increases the Skill by 5. You can have a maximum of four Advances in a Skill and four Advances in a Specialisation. Purchasing new Talents costs 100 XP each. Additionally, during character creation, your character may gain Talents or Advancements that they do not meet the requirements for. This is the only exception to the rule; whenever you purchase any other Advance or a Talent with XP, you must meet the listed requirements.
